occurrences.reason: In attachment 1 (the page 145 scan), at the printed 邊 entry after “形声字。” and before “金文或从”, the punctuation after 辵 is visibly a full-width Chinese comma, with the broad curved mark of ， rather than the short baseline mark of an ASCII comma.
